description: Header file defining the class 'data_flow_cplane_downlink_task_dispatcher' which manages scheduling and dispatching of control-plane data flow tasks for fronthaul communication, including methods for starting, stopping, and enqueuing messages, with external dependencies on task execution, synchronization, and logging.

classes.name: data_flow_cplane_downlink_task_dispatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for dispatching control-plane scheduling commands and beamforming messages in a fronthaul system, managing task execution, synchronization, and logging.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns a reference to the operation controller interface implemented by this class.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Resets the stop manager to start processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the stop manager to stop processing.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message
methods.description: Enqueues a control-plane type 1 message for processing, respecting stop requests and deferring execution to the task executor.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_3_prach_message
methods.description: Enqueues a control-plane type 3 PRACH message, with similar handling as other enqueue methods.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Retrieves the metrics collector associated with the data flow.
